title: Python Developer - Full Stack
responsibilities: Develop and maintain web application features using Python and React.
Build REST APIs using Python and FastAPI.
Develop reusable frontend components using React and JavaScript.
Work with relational and NoSQL databases to implement application functionality.
Write unit tests and participate in debugging and code reviews.
Integrate third-party APIs and internal services.
Collaborate with senior engineers to design and implement production features.
Follow Git-based development and software engineering best practices.
description: We are looking for a Python Developer to join our product engineering team. The role is suitable for fresh graduates with strong programming fundamentals and an interest in full-stack web development. The engineer will work across Python backend services, REST APIs, React-based interfaces, databases, and cloud-ready application development.
